reason: The plugin is primarily a UI customization plugin for the DSH web client: it rotates image/video wallpapers and applies visual presentation controls (blur, dimming, shadows, transparency) while neutralizing existing panel styles, which aligns it with page theme/layout enhancement rather than automation or data-processing tasks.

summaries.zh: 该插件是面向 dsh Web 的界面美化插件，用于设置可轮换的图片/视频壁纸并调节模糊、压暗与透明度等显示效果。
summaries.en: This plugin is a dsh web interface theme plugin that lets users set rotating image/video wallpapers and adjust display options such as blur, dimming, and opacity.

capabilities: Applies web UI visual theming and layout adjustments for the DSH interface
Rotates local image and video files as background wallpapers
Injects DOM/CSS changes to neutralize panel backgrounds and preserve readability overlays

reasons.code: README states the plugin supports folder-based image/video wallpaper rotation with cross-fade transitions and supports mp4/webm/mov/m4v files.
README describes full-page wallpaper support by traversing DOM and clearing opaque panel backgrounds, and removal of decorative mask layers for clearer background rendering.
package.json declares the plugin client platform as web (lib/client.js export), confirming browser-side interface modification behavior.
